ValidationRule.description: CIC Frontline Agent should only be able to assign a case to Floor Operation Queue.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'US'), CONTAINS( $UserRole.Name ,'CCNA Frontline'), ISCHANGED( OwnerId ), NOT(Owner:Queue.DeveloperName == 'CCNA_FOS_Queue' ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are only allowed to assign a case to Floor Operations Supervisor Queue.
